definitions.explanation: Something that causes negative effects or damage to people, things, or situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{害|がい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧。
examples.english: Food that is harmful to the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦タバコ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{害|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.notes: Common construction: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{害|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧

examples.japanese: {害|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えないで→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{害|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should stop actions that harm the environment.
This medicine is harmful to the body if you take too much.

notes:
{害|がい} means harm, damage, or negative effect.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{害|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be harmful to X)
- {害|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to cause harm)
- {害|がい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive harm, to be harmed)
- {害|がい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become harmful)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧ (pest, harmful insect)
- ⟦{公害|こうがい}→公害：14944_kougai⟧ (pollution)
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage, harm suffered)
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧ (damage, loss)
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧ (harmful)
- ⟦{無害|むがい}→無害：25474_mugai⟧ (harmless)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{益|えき}→益：02275_eki⟧ (benefit)
